FORM NO. 3
G. 658-1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
C. S. 6, Special Branch. 9151
REPORT
Date April 22, 1939 39

Subject (in full) Japanese Officials Dinner Held at Zoh Yu Restaurant
(蜀川菜館 ) 235/7 Kwangse Road.

Made by D. S. Vischenko Forwarded by Inspector 3 Copy

In compliance with instructions contained
in the attached memo., the undersigned accompanied by
Waung Pei Yuen
C.D.C. 107 was on observation duty between 6.30 p.m.
and 9 p.m. April 21, 1939, at the Zoh Yu Restaurant
(蜀川菜館 ) 235/7 Kwangse Road, where a party
of about 10 Japanese Consular Officials had a dinner
party between the aforementioned hours. At the same
time another Japanese party of about eight persons
reported to consist of members of the Japanese Banking
Association also had a dinner there.

No untoward incident took place.

V. Mischenko.
D. S.

FILE
J.B.
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
22/4.
D. C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ____
C. S. 6，特别处。 9151
报告
日期 1939年4月22日 39

主题（全称） 日本官员在蜀川菜馆（Zoh Yu Restaurant）举行的晚宴
地址：广西路235/7号。

呈报人 D. S. Vischenko 经由警司转呈 副本 3

遵照附函备忘录中的指示，下述签署人会同
Waung Pei Yuen
C.D.C. 107 于1939年4月21日下午6时30分至晚上9时，
在广西路235/7号的蜀川菜馆（Zoh Yu Restaurant）执行观察任务，
在此期间，约有10名日本领事馆官员在该处举行晚宴。
同时，另一批约八人的日本团体，据称由日本银行公会成员组成，
也在该处用餐。

未发生任何意外事件。

V. Mischenko.
D. S.

归档
J.B.
助理处长（特别处）致 副处长
4月22日。
副处长（特别处）。
